sections.heading: 1. Four steps
lines: ① Tap the link in bio → booking page.
② Pick Chatswood or Sydney CBD.
③ Physio, chiro, clinical Pilates or massage.
④ Pick a time, add details, confirm!

sections.heading: 2. Initial or follow-up?
lines: First visit for this problem? Usually initial.
Unsure? Call or message the clinic.

caption:
Booking an appointment shouldn't take longer than your lunch break. Mr Turtle learnt that the easy way 📱

Here's the quick version: tap the link in our bio, choose Chatswood or Sydney CBD, then pick physio, chiro, clinical Pilates or remedial massage. Choose an initial or follow-up visit, pick a time that suits, add your details and confirm. You'll get a confirmation with the time and address.

If it's your first visit for a new problem, an initial appointment is usually the right choice. Not sure which service fits? Give the clinic a call or send a message and our admin team will help you work out where to start.

Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
